name: harness
description: The function-hook adapter of the third engine's harness (harness-design.md §4.4, §5): the map and the local facts as a context block that names this session, refreshed after a Bash call that ran an instrument. Enabled by .claude/settings.json from the repository's own marketplace, harness@dax-php; the shipped command hooks in .claude/skills/third-engine-harness stay the sensor of record.
